known_limitations: PWL replay is offline verification stimulus: this is not a mixed-signal co-simulation and not an on-chip digital driver; real driver impedance is outside the model.

The eight PAM current levels are not implemented; pam_sel=7 is a request code and no analog decoding is claimed.
Only TT at 27 C, one output clamp at 1.2 V, one channel. No corner, temperature, MC, LED model, array RC, layout or SOA.

Ical and every window conclusion depend on the reused calibration run r5_cal; the black-code window and code-1 window are re-measured from the retained r9_main / r10_main runs with their deck and raw digests recorded, and no process was started for them in the delivery pass.
Spectre launches: the task book authorises 52, four more were granted for this round after three of my own tool defects cost failed launches; every launch including failures is in process_ledger.csv.

The pre-existing unreachable blob still fails the --mode objects hygiene scan on this machine (same identity as recorded in DATA-7A/R4). It was not printed, GCed, exempted or rewritten, and no claim of a fully clean object store is made.
